title: Nedunchalai
desc: Murugan, plays a cat and mouse game with Insp. Masani after stealing from trucks.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoomi is all set to get married but her life changes when Vishal and his cousin rape her. She and her father set out to punish the perpetrators.

title: Ponmagal Vandhal
desc: A courageous lawyer defends a woman labelled a serial killer, uncovering a web of child abuse and corruption in her pursuit of justice.

desc: Krishna, an orphan raised by gym owner Sarkar, overcomes adversity to become a wrestler. However, conflict arises with his mentor when he falls in love.

desc: Maathen, a gang member, accidentally kills a police officer and plans to meet his beloved Aparna before leaving, escalating the suspense surrounding his life.

desc: Teenager June navigates adolescent crushes, heartbreaks, and insecurities, evolving into a mature and confident woman.

title: Sagodharargal
desc: Separated at childhood, a set of triplets find their calling in life. Years later, when they cross paths, an old grudge surfaces as a bone of contention.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: Compilation of catchy Tamil songs by notable artists from various movies.

title: Burma
desc: Burma, who seizes high-priced cars to earn a living, must race against time to steal cars for a gangster or end up losing his life.

title: 30 Natlalil Kadhalipadhu Yaepadi?
desc: Two college students initially dislike each other but later discover a past-life connection when they face a challenging situation.
